content.text:
Updated `src/solution.py` to:
- Accept three-letter weekday abbreviations.
- Allow any positive integer duration, with starts on 15-minute boundaries.
- Include Friday starts at 15:00 but exclude later starts.
- Prevent out-of-hours events from producing invalid slots.

Preserved lunch exclusions, working-hour limits, and event buffers. All checks passed, including 500 randomized calendars.
